ambient_events: The griddle hisses as someone flips something grey.
The coffee urn gurgles like it resents being awake.
description: A long chrome-and-vinyl diner gone soft at the edges — cracked booths, a griddle that never fully cools, and a coffee urn that has seen the end of the world and kept pouring. A chalk menu on the wall promises CALORIES, HONESTLY PRICED.
name: Ration Nine
